settings.ggv_FKf50k__text:
To apply the Gudslip® Mouth Tape, first ensure your lips and the surrounding area are clean and dry to secure adherence. Place the tape over your mouth, pressing gently to ensure it sticks firmly, which promotes nose breathing and reduces snoring. 

 

For the Gudslip® Nose Strip, begin by cleaning and drying the bridge of your nose. Remove the strip from its packaging, peel off the protective liner, and place the strip across the bridge of your nose. Press down firmly to ensure it adheres properly, opening up your nasal passages for improved airflow and a quieter sleep.

settings.ggcx6K9I5mh_text:
The Gudslip® Enhanced Sleep Pack is specifically formulated to tackle two common sleep issues: snoring and disrupted breathing. It includes the following:

 

Mouth Tape: Keeps the mouth closed to encourage nasal breathing, reducing snoring and the discomfort of dry mouth.


Nose Strip: Gently widens the nasal passages, enhancing airflow and making breathing easier and quieter. 

 

Pack Contents:

- 30 Mouth Tapes
- 30 Nose Strips


The Gudslip® Enhanced Sleep Pack is your go-to solution for achieving quieter, more comfortable sleep. Whether you are home or traveling, this pack ensures that you maintain optimal breathing all night, helping you to wake refreshed and energized every morning.
